brief.changes: eval/ (MANIFEST.json sha256 edb04f7a556e) shipped as d350_eval/ beside code/ commit 43e8326c85c1 (the training commit, needed to load the checkpoint). No training; reads the run record and the cache; writes score-s<k>.json into the run directory.

expected_metrics.expectation: one finite number or INVALID[<class>]: <reason> as the last log line
expected_metrics.name: score

limitations: Certification and replay run on CPU (as the pilot readout did); the score is not a result before a VERIFY.md.
brief.purpose: Score run baseline-e-350k-s1-a1 (d350-baseline-e-350k-s1) with the frozen discovery-350k evaluator (PROPOSAL.md §4), epochs < 1000; CPU only.

stop_rules.condition: any failure, nonzero exit or deadline

args:
set -euo pipefail
trap 'rc=$?; echo "INVALID[infrastructure]: score job setup failed exit=$rc line=${LINENO}"' EXIT
export KERAS_BACKEND=tensorflow MPLBACKEND=Agg TF_CPP_MIN_LOG_LEVEL=2
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 TF_NUM_INTRAOP_THREADS=2 TF_NUM_INTEROP_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1
mkdir -p /work/code
echo 'b6c79b2549cdb74ff137b807fd9086dcd034ee5b1ad5cc6cc30c176d1311dba1  /cmcode/hgq2.tar.gz' | sha256sum -c -
tar -xzf /cmcode/hgq2.tar.gz -C /work/code --strip-components=1
export PYTHONPATH=/work/code
export BNJ_DATA_ROOT=/data/chang-n64-20260926 BNJ_RUN_ROOT=/data/discovery-350k-20261008/attempts/baseline-e-350k-s1-a1 BNJ_CAMPAIGN_DIR=/work/code/campaigns/d350
export BNJ_STAGE=production
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=-1 WANDB_MODE=disabled
pip install -q --no-cache-dir -r /work/code/requirements-cpu.txt
cd /work/code
MSHA=$(python -c "import run_study; print(run_study.manifest()['sha256'])")
test "$MSHA" = "e6ff034bfc44580a44fc96a27fedcd302f43babbef70169e90802f4ea9a0a8e3" || { echo "MANIFEST_SHA_MISMATCH $MSHA"; exit 1; }
echo "MANIFEST_SHA_OK $MSHA"
export BNHGQ2_CODE_SHA256="$MSHA"
test -f /data/chang-n64-20260926/n64/data/READY.json || { echo "cache not ready: /data/chang-n64-20260926/n64/data"; exit 1; }
test -d /data/discovery-350k-20261008/attempts/baseline-e-350k-s1-a1/runs/d350-baseline-e-350k-s1 || { echo "run dir missing: /data/discovery-350k-20261008/attempts/baseline-e-350k-s1-a1/runs/d350-baseline-e-350k-s1"; exit 1; }
trap - EXIT
RC=0
python -u /work/code/d350_eval/score.py /data/discovery-350k-20261008/attempts/baseline-e-350k-s1-a1/runs/d350-baseline-e-350k-s1 --stop-epoch 1000 --expect-target 350000 --cache /data/chang-n64-20260926/n64/data --code /work/code > /work/score.out 2>&1 || RC=$?
cat /work/score.out
F=/data/discovery-350k-20261008/attempts/baseline-e-350k-s1-a1/runs/d350-baseline-e-350k-s1/score-s1.json
if [ -f "$F" ]; then echo SCORE_JSON_BEGIN; cat "$F"; echo; echo SCORE_JSON_END; fi
tail -n 1 /work/score.out
exit $RC
